card.title: Faster Loads With Lazy Routes and @defer

a1.cap: Cut the initial bundle: lazy-load the admin area only when visited, and defer rendering a heavy chart component until it scrolls into view, with a placeholder and loading state.

a1.cap: A route's loadComponent uses a dynamic import(), so its code becomes a separate chunk fetched on first navigation.
a1.say: A route's load Component uses a dynamic import, so its code becomes a separate chunk fetched on first navigation.

a1.cap: Inside templates, @defer lazily loads the components in its block when a trigger fires, such as on viewport, and shows @placeholder and @loading content meanwhile.
a1.say: Inside templates, at defer lazily loads the components in its block when a trigger fires, such as on viewport, and shows at placeholder and at loading content meanwhile.

a1.cap: Dynamic import splits the admin page into its own chunk, downloaded on first visit.
The chart's code loads only when the placeholder scrolls into view.
The placeholder shows before loading starts; it's also what the viewport trigger watches.
The loading block shows for at least 300 milliseconds to avoid flicker.
